THE SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICES LONG SERVICE MEDAL AND CLASP

IT is hereby notified that His Excellency the President has been pleased to award the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long ServiceMedal & Clasp to the persons specified in the schedule hereto.

By His Excellency’s Command,

B.M.U.D. BASNAYAKE,Secretary,Ministry of Defence.07th May 2015,At Colombo.
